slots.node01.text: Pattern 1: Lakehouse as the analytics layer over the existing warehouse
slots.node03.text: Curated warehouse → Semantic services → BI layer
slots.node04.text: ROLE: Native analytics and consumption over data governed in the warehouse
slots.node06.text: Pattern 2: Lakehouse as the consumption layer for the engineering platform
slots.node08.text: Engineering platform → Curated layer → BI layer
slots.node09.text: ROLE: Business consumption while engineering and curation stay put
slots.node13.text: Ingestion and engineering → Lakehouse → Semantic and reporting
slots.node14.text: ROLE: One platform for qualified net-new workloads
slots.source.text: West Monroe analysis of the Northfield data estate.
slots.title: Three patterns define the lakehouse role
